script_text: Something seismic is hitting your financial sector this week, Taurus. Your ruling planet Venus forms a trine with Pluto in your 8th House, unlocking sudden career and money gains early in the week. However, Mercury squares Saturn in your 5th House on Tuesday, making romance feel deeply frustrating and daytime communication chaotic. The energy shifts dramatically Wednesday when the Sun squares Uranus, disrupting your 2nd House stability and forcing you to completely recalibrate your personal budget. As Venus enters your 10th House Thursday, your Earth element really grounds this cosmic chaos. This brings professional recognition and weekend love connections that feel deeply destined. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters your 10th House. Tuesday is your worst day due to the Mercury square Saturn aspect. Use this Earth sign patience to carefully review your enduring investments before Friday finally arrives. Follow for daily updates.
